title: Track Mix 3-Mix Duo #22 (임산부 세로 띠·물결 / 일반 동심원·물결)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each from a different look, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: Japanese, in her mid 50s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size — but projecting forward prominently from that waistline, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, every other curve of her oversized at once around it: enormous round hips flaring out more than three times the waistline's width, gigantic soft thighs. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, deeply sun-tanned bronze makeup over real skin, bold white eyeshadow across the lids, white glossy lips, a bright turquoise liner accent at the outer corners, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a bright cheeky grin, bold vivid electric-blue hair styled in a natural afro in a full rounded silhouette, real pores, real living eyes, 3 drop dangles piercings set with sapphires in bronze-toned metal, wearing a single piece of gold a ring. Fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 vertical bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 38% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 65% of the way across her figure from her left edge. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it carries applied ELECTRIC MAGENTA leaf, thin irregular metallic sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID SILVER undertone glinting through the thinnest points. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries polished obsidian stone fused directly to her own form, solid glossy black stone curving to follow her body's true shape, with molten gold seams running between fitted stone sections. Region 3 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it carries deep black ebony wood fused directly into her own form, natural fine grain lines flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING glossy jet-black grain with VIVID dark-brown highlight streaks. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: kneeling on both knees facing the camera directly, both hands resting lightly atop the dome of her belly, serene direct eye contact, her extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Japanese, in her early 50s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone — an enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, smooth healthy skin, defined brown-mauve eyeshadow, a precise winged liner, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, softly contoured cheeks, glossy rose-nude lips, a poised, mature, confident expression, cool ash-brown hair styled in high ponytail, real pores, real living eyes, 50 a mix of hoops, studs and drops piercings set with pearls in mixed metal-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of silver an anklet. Fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 60% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 2 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 29% and 53% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it carries polished obsidian stone fused directly to her own form, solid glossy black stone curving to follow her body's true shape, with molten gold seams running between fitted stone sections. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, fudo myo-o flames formations in ELECTRIC ORANGE and GOLD, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 3 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a perfectly circular course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip, her extreme platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
